judgment_text:
Prayer : Contempt Petition is filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 praying to punish the contemnor/first respondent for his willful and deliberate disobedience by not carrying out the orders of this Court in W.P.(MD) No. 31584 of 2025, dated 06.11.2025

ORDER

This contempt case has been filed by the petitioner complaining willful disobedience of the order dated 06.11.2025, in W.P.(MD) No. 31584 of 2025, passed by this Court.

2. Today, when the matter is taken up for consideration, learned counsel on either side submitted that the respondent/contemnor has complied with the order passed by this Court by issuing a proceedings dated 18.02.2026.

3. In the said circumstances, this contempt petition is closed.
